source_name: Росстат: оперативный годовой итог рождаемости за 2024 год
acquisition: Direct reading of the official publication in desktop browser; a short displayed-text excerpt is archived, not the original HTTP bytes. No raw-original checksum is asserted.
methodology: Published operational total of live births for the full calendar year. The December-only figure and rounded marriages count are excluded. No regional average or inferred values.
comparability_limits: The press release does not detail territorial coverage or all statistical methodology footnotes. One RF total for 2024 does not establish a 5-year national series or coverage of 89 regions. No same-year regional comparison is currently possible. Observations have no publication timestamp because the source timezone is not established; the known publication date is retained here.
